Charge-share vector: parametrize by the resolution profile q_0 = P(ell=0), q_1 = P(ell=1), Q_2 = P(ell>=2). Nearest-ancestor charging gives EXACTLY: s_root = q_0 (root receives ONLY depth-0 records - nothing charges up past depth 1, a small correction to the claim's 'root gets depth-0 symbols + ...'); s_{each depth-1 cell} = q_1/3 + Q_2/9 (own depth-1 share + its repeat-digit subtree aa*, which carries 1/9 of all deep records); s_{each mapped depth-2 cell} = Q_2/9 (own subtree, nothing else - confirmed). Mixed thirds: (1/3; 4/27 x3; 1/27 x6). (b) F2: region rho congests when s_rho*N > Gamma, i.e. N > Gamma/s_rho. Congestion order = decreasing share: depth-1 cells always congest no later than mapped depth-2 cells (share difference exactly q_1/3, so strict iff q_1 > 0); root's rank depends on q_0 (first when q_0 > q_1/3 + Q_2/9, never when q_0 = 0). E[rho_rec(d)]/N = P(ell >= d) = 1 - q_0 - ... - q_{d-1}, nonincreasing in d. Two-regime form under resolutions bounded by map depth 2: E[rho_rec(d)]/N = P(ell >= d) for d in {0,1,2} and = 0 for d >= 3; at full maturity (Q_2 = 1, all ell = 2) this is rho_rec = N for d <= 2 and 0 beyond - flat then cliff.
